ocr.markdown:
7 cups Kellogg's® Crispix® cereal
1 cup mixed nuts
1 cup pretzels
3 tablespoons margarine, melted
1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
1/4 teaspoon onion salt
2 teaspoons lemon juice
4 teaspoons French's®*
Worcestershire Sauce

1. Combine Kellogg's® Crispix® cereal, nuts and pretzels in 13 x 9 x 2-inch
   baking pan. Set aside.
2. Stir together remaining ingredients. Gently stir spices and margarine into
   cereal mixture until evenly coated.
3. Bake at 250°F about 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on
   paper towels to cool. Store in airtight container.

YIELD: About 9 cups

NUTRITION FACTS: Serving size 1/2 cup (28 grams) Calories 110 • Fat cal 54 • % Daily Value
Total fat 10% (6g) • Sat fat 5% (1g) • Cholest 0% (0mg) • Sodium 11% (260mg) • Total carb 5% (14g) •
Fiber 5% (1g) • Sugars 2g • Protein 2g • Vitamin A 10% • Vitamin C 10% • Calcium 0% • Iron 6%

NOTE: Dry roasted mixed nuts may be used in place of regular mixed nuts and reduced calorie margarine
for regular margarine.

® Kellogg Company © 1997 Kellogg Company
* FRENCH'S and the pennant design are trademarks of Reckitt & Colman Inc.
